## Research

My research is on the application of Statistics. My current interests are in Wastewater-based Epidemiology where I am co-director of [CWBE](https://cwbe.ac.uk/)



## Education

- PhD in Statistics, 1987 --- University of California, Berkeley
- BA in Mathematics, 1982 --- University of Cambridge
